text:
Maya: heads-up — IvyCrest dedicated slice planned traffic shift tomorrow 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need go/no-go by 01:00 UTC. Plan: pin model to v2.3.1, route 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds, reserve +20% burst, prewarm KV cache. Post any hold blockers now.
Jason: pin done in canary config, pushed manifest: `slice: ivycrest\nmodel: v2.3.1\npin: true`.
Lee: reserved burst pool with infra — requested 4x machines for the window, autoscaler disabled for the slice during shift.
Elaine: CS notified IvyCrest PM, they're on standby for customer-side tests during 50% step. Asked to avoid any schema changes.
Tom: QA ran smoke on v2.3.1 with sample prompts, no diffs vs prod baseline. 95th p90 latency delta +12ms. logs: `ok, 120ms -> 132ms`.
Nina: noted rollback criteria: errors >1% sustained 10m OR p95 > 450ms for 5m. Agreed?
Maya: yes those thresholds; add immediate rollback if token-generation failures spike or if function-calling regressions observed.
deploy-bot: [deploy plan created] IvyCrest shift plan id: dp-ivy-20260322-01. Steps: canary-pin -> prewarm -> route-10% -> hold-15m -> route-50% -> hold-15m -> route-100% -> verify -> complete. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ivycrest-shift
Jason: prewarm command ready: `redwood prewarm --slice ivycrest --kv --concurrency 8` — will run 30m before window.
Lee: I'm on-call for the window, will watch infra metrics and latency dashboards. Pager escalation set to SRE primary.
Elaine: customer asked for a short release note blurb for their compliance team: "Pinned model v2.3.1 for deterministic inference, no data migration required." Sending now.
Tom: adding a quick smoke test to run after each shift step: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/ivycrest/test -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` and compare hashes.
Maya: request approvals: Maya (release), Jason (eng), Lee (infra), Nina (SRE), Elaine (CS). Please reply with ✅ to approve or mention blockers.
Jason: ✅
Lee: ✅ infra ready
Nina: ✅ will watch SLIs
Elaine: ✅ CS cleared with customer
Tom: ✅ QA clear
Maya: all approvals, locking the window. Quick reminders: rollback playbook pinned at /playbooks/ivycrest-rollback.md, ensure logs collection retained for 72h. I'll trigger deploy plan 60m before window for dry-run.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] dp-ivy-20260322-01 scheduled to start at 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z (dry-run). Notifying on-call and ops channels.
Maya: thanks team — I'll post a final go/no-go at 01:00 UTC. If anything changes, ping here or call the SRE on-call.
